policies.title: Encryption at Rest
policies.requirement: Vendor must encrypt stored customer data using AES-256 or an accepted equivalent.
policies.expected_commitment: An explicit AES-256 or equivalent encryption-at-rest commitment.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add an explicit encryption-at-rest commitment using AES-256 or an approved equivalent.

policies.title: Breach Notification
policies.requirement: Vendor must notify the customer of a confirmed security incident within 72 hours.
policies.expected_commitment: A notification deadline no longer than 72 hours after confirmation.
policies.remediation_guidance: Amend the notification deadline to 72 hours or less after confirmation.

policies.title: Audit Rights
policies.requirement: Customer must have contractual rights to audit or inspect the vendor security controls.
policies.expected_commitment: An explicit customer audit, inspection, or independent-assurance access right.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add a proportionate audit and inspection rights clause.

policies.title: Data Retention
policies.requirement: The contract must define a specific retention period or objective deletion trigger after termination.
policies.expected_commitment: A measurable retention period or clearly defined deletion event.
policies.remediation_guidance: Define a specific retention period and deletion timeline.

policies.title: Subprocessor Notification
policies.requirement: Vendor must provide prior notice before appointing a new material subprocessor, without an exception that permits appointment before notice.
policies.expected_commitment: Prior notification in all material-subprocessor appointment scenarios.
policies.remediation_guidance: Remove or narrow the urgent appointment exception and require prompt prior notice or customer approval.
